items.title: Stacked sessions and pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app
items.summary: I want you to look at this screenshot for a moment from the GitHub Copilot app . It’s a small one, it’s got a lot of icons, and it tells the most glorious story that I’m really excited about. This image is a set of stacked sessions. They’re a series of tasks in the same repository, where each session builds off each other! More on those below, but first, why is this screenshot so magical? We need to go back more than
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了在GitHub Copilot应用中使用堆叠会话（stacked sessions）和计划模式（Plan mode）来完成复杂软件重构任务的实际案例。通过将一千多行10年前的遗留代码（React 15和Less等）分解为多个互相堆叠、逐步推进的Agent子任务，开发者展示了AI Agent在处理多步骤、跨依赖代码库现代化的强大实用价值与具体工作流。

items.title: Investigating three incidents in our cybersecurity evaluations
items.summary: We found three cases where a Claude model reached the internet from an evaluation environment and accessed real systems. We share what happened and what we're changing.
items.summaryZh: Anthropic发布了针对大模型网络安全评估的深度报告，详细调查并复盘了三次真实世界中的安全事件。该研究评估了先进模型在攻防对抗、漏洞挖掘和自动化安全审计中的表现，旨在为构建更安全的AI系统和健全模型安全护栏提供科学的数据支撑。
